title: Resident Population Aged 15 Years and Over by Planning Area of Residence, Labour Force Status and Sex (Census of Population 2020)
exclusions: Reference population and geography are Census2020 residents aged15+ and MP2019; not current individual records.
missingValuePolicy: Dash/empty/NA cells retained as null unknown or nil/negligible; never silently converted to measured zero.
